name: Nabal
summary: A rich man of Maon with flocks at Carmel, harsh and evil in what he did, who refused to help David's men. The LORD struck him, and he died ten days after he learned his wife Abigail had gone out to meet David.

key_moments.title: Insulting David's Men
key_moments.description: At sheep-shearing time David sent ten young men to ask Nabal for food. Nabal asked who David was and sent them away with nothing, so David and his men put on their swords.

key_moments.title: The LORD Strikes Him
key_moments.description: Nabal held a feast like a king and got very drunk. In the morning Abigail told him what had happened, his heart died within him, and ten days later the LORD struck him and he died.
